findings.problem: [confirmed] Hybrid retrieval treats dense similarity as an alternative to positive-IDF lexical coverage, informative-term overlap, and the calibrated raw BM25 floor, so lexically unsupported medical context can be marked supported.
findings.required_fix: Require the calibrated lexical predicate in every retrieval mode; use dense and reranker thresholds only to rank or further restrict candidates, and add dense-near/lexically-unsupported regression tests for mvp_hybrid and full.

findings.problem: [confirmed] Retrieval calibration omits the required typo and negation adversaries; Gate A instead calibrates against document questions and four hard-coded unrelated queries, so zero false support is claimed for a reduced evaluation set.
findings.required_fix: Add answerable plus typo, entity-swap, negation, random, and irrelevant rows to the committed evaluation data, make Gate A use that exact set, and test that every category participates in calibration.

findings.problem: [confirmed] Full and hybrid calibration readiness does not revalidate the custom golden-file evaluation hash; a full index remains ready after its evaluation set changes.
findings.required_fix: Persist the evaluation source and digest for every calibration mode, validate them on every load, and add stale-evaluation tests for bm25_only, mvp_hybrid, and full.

findings.problem: [confirmed] The API accepts odd, assistant-first, duplicate-role, and broken-middle histories and silently filters them instead of enforcing complete alternating user/assistant pairs.
findings.required_fix: Add model-level history validation for even length and exact alternating roles, return the normalized 422 response, and cover malformed sequences in schema and API tests.

findings.problem: [confirmed] Gate C evaluation never sends adversarial prompts to the adapter, counts rule-based query classifications as adversarial evidence, and allows positive unsafe_candidate_count while finalize checks only nonzero counts. An unsafe, adversarially untested adapter can be marked COMPLETED.
findings.required_fix: Generate adapter responses for the required adversarial/safety cases, record and hash per-case outcomes, enforce zero unsafe or the locked safety thresholds, and make finalize reject incomplete, unsafe, or invocation-only smoke evidence.

findings.problem: [confirmed] Final derivation copies Gate A status and retains any Gate C COMPLETED report without revalidating current inputs, required artifacts, or artifact hashes, allowing stale or edited reports to drive the final summary.
findings.required_fix: Implement side-effect-free Gate A and Gate C evidence validators, invoke them during derivation, and add forged/stale report tests that fail closed when any required artifact or hash is absent.

findings.problem: [confirmed] The required complete verifier fails with six mypy errors in lightning.py, download.py, and preparation.py, so the checked-in CI workflow is red and later orchestration stages do not run.
findings.required_fix: Correct the no-any-return annotations, remove unused ignores and redundant casts, then rerun scripts/verify_all.sh successfully end to end.

findings.problem: [confirmed] Existing valid cache directories are deleted before os.replace commits the verified replacement; a filesystem failure can destroy the last valid cache.
findings.required_fix: Use an atomic pointer or rename-and-rollback activation that preserves the old target until commit, with injected failure tests for downloaded and cached activation paths.

findings.problem: [confirmed] Handoff archive validation has no compressed-size, expanded-size, per-member-size, or member-count limits and can exhaust disk before integrity validation.
findings.required_fix: Apply explicit limits before and during streamed extraction and add oversized-member, excessive-member, and high-expansion archive tests.

findings.problem: [confirmed] MedQuAD is labeled Apache 2.0 in configuration but CC0-1.0 in documentation, so generated attribution and operator guidance can disagree about redistribution obligations.
findings.required_fix: Verify the exact selected Kaggle version's license, use the same exact value in configuration and documentation, and regenerate attribution evidence after real acquisition.
